role: Historical controlled render experiment; not a live registry or formal release receipt

method.A: Instrumented baseline b3; no paint or pixel-cache optimization
method.B: p2; partial main-HUD repaint plus bounded immutable pixel cache
method.primaryStatistic: Median of four per-trial means, except explicitly named per-trial quantiles
method.gpuQuantiles: Per-trial retained ring of at most 256 completed query pairs; GPU means use epoch totals
method.cpuScope: Whole fixture process, expressed as percent of one CPU core; not live game Host or total-machine percent
method.gpuScope: Asynchronous timestamp intervals around world/effects and HUD upload/draw; excludes WGC capture, atlas upload, Present, DWM and scanout

workloads.static: Frozen source and all visual clocks; zero repaint/copy/upload/composition required
workloads.hud_only: Real main-HUD painters at 30Hz and resource animation timer; no new WGC source frames
workloads.mixed: Same HUD plus 30Hz source, production bullet/effect atlases, 192 deterministic bullets, 8 dynamic lights and 160 snow particles

selectedChanges: Damage-clipped main-HUD repaint with full repaint for geometry/lifecycle/unknown invalidations
Native pixel buffers reused only with exclusive cache ownership; three entries per layer, 32 MiB total cap
boundary: Controlled production-painter fixture, not real battle FPS
No DWM/MPO, total GPU power, thermals, weak-machine or physical-input qualification
No formal runtime promotion; isolated candidates only

outcome.label: arena-baseline-01
outcome.boundary: Actual isolated candidate and dedicated cloned save; explicit mixed arena roster. Not balance, fully seeded battle or weak-machine/physical-input acceptance.

outcome.label: arena-final-01
outcome.boundary: Actual isolated candidate and dedicated cloned save; explicit mixed arena roster. Not balance, fully seeded battle or weak-machine/physical-input acceptance.

finalCandidate.manifestDifference: producerRecipeHash and buildIdentityHash changed after main integration
finalCandidate.executionScope: Owned WGC/D3D fixture; prior p2 live-game entry is recorded separately
